entries.note: Flush hit, best of the range session.

Warm-up block, one of 10 shots (8 good, 1 toe, 1 top per user). Toptracer also showed flat carry 94.7yd, curve 10ft, landing angle 25deg, hang time 3.2s — none of those map to existing schema fields, kept here for reference. Offline distance not shown on this screen.

Sequencing drill block (step-change-of-direction + pump-drill). Very low launch/apex for a 7i — thin/low contact, consistent with the drill isolating a new movement rather than a clean strike. Offline converted from 23ft right shown on screen (Toptracer displayed this in feet, not yards).
Sequencing drill block. Best-contact shot of the three visible — launch/apex/carry all close to a normal strike. Offline converted from 14ft left shown on screen.

Sequencing drill block. Large miss — 53.7yd right is a big outlier versus the other two shots' offline. Offline converted from 161ft right shown on screen; worth noting but not alarming given this drill block is explicitly about grooving a new movement pattern, not contact quality.

Toptracer's own rolling average across the sequencing drill block (25 balls total) — the representative number for the block, not a single strike. The 3 individually-logged shots (st-2026-09-27-7i-a/b/c) were just the last 3 shown on screen and shouldn't be read as the whole block's story, especially the 53.7yd outlier. Average offline shown as 6ft (~2yd) with no direction arrow on screen, so left null rather than guessing left/right.

Contact drill block (impact tape + coin-under-ball). User switched from 7i to 8i partway through purely so Toptracer would chart the two blocks as separate clusters, not for any coaching reason. Curve/offline arrow pointed left; offline converted from 68ft.
Contact drill block. Offline converted from 40ft left shown on screen.
Contact drill block. Offline converted from 107ft left shown on screen — largest miss of the three visible, same left pattern as the other two.

Toptracer's rolling average across the full 25-ball contact block — the representative number, per the lesson from the previous block (don't over-read the last 3 individual shots). Average offline shown as 38ft with no clear direction arrow, so left null. Notably: same 106mph ball speed as the earlier 7i sequencing-block average, but higher carry (117 vs 99yd), higher launch (12 vs 8deg) and nearly double the apex (38 vs 21ft) despite 8i having less loft than 7i -- consistent with the user's own read that contact was improving as the session went on.
